messages:
DeployBot: Started canary deploy 'canary-aurora' -> prod (5 nodes) at 3305002000. image: runtime:v2.14.3 :rocket:

Alex: @SRE-Oncall seeing p95 jump from 120ms to ~820ms on /v1/generate, p99 off the charts, lots of 504/gateway timeouts. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/board/xyz

SRE-Oncall: Paging now. this looks like a deploy-induced regression. tagging as incident, paging oncall. @Maria can you triage the canary?

Maria: looking. initial tail logs show a spike of `connection reset by peer` and `timeout waiting for kv-cache` from runtime shards. Not classic cpu - CPU stable.

EngRuntime: Confirmed. We shipped a netty keepalive tweak and a new pooling behavior in v2.14.3 that modifies idle connection eviction. Hypothesis: new pool shrink + long tail requests -> TCP churn -> timeouts at gateway p99.

SRE-Oncall: mitigation plan: 1) pause canary traffic 2) rollback canary to v2.14.2 3) if rollback doesn't help, scale timeout buffers. Can one of you run the rollback?

OpsLead: I'm on it. running rollback on canary group now.

OpsLead: Command run:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/canary-aurora --to-revision=stable-214
```

DeployBot: Rollback accepted, starting rollout undo.

Alex: After rollback started, p95 trending down to ~150ms, p99 dropping. Still seeing some 504s from in-flight requests.

CS-Emma: Notifying CS triage: some customers reported intermittent request timeouts (~1-2% sessions) starting ~5m ago. Opening support ticket list.

Maria: Logs after rollback show fewer `kv-cache` wait errors. Snapshot: `avg_kv_wait_ms` fell from 1200 -> 40 over 90s. Good sign.

EngRuntime: We should also revert the pooling patch in the feature branch and run a perf test. For immediate, we need a hotfix that preserves previous pooling behavior. Filing PR now.

SRE-Oncall: Marking incident as mitigated (rollback confirmed, error rates returned to baseline). Creating follow-up checklist: RCA owner, postmortem, customer impact assessment.

OpsLead: Created channel #incident-3305002022 for postmortem and assigned owners: Maria (RCA), EngRuntime (fix/rollback PR), Alex (monitoring/alerts tuning), CS-Emma (customer comms). Priority: P2 (lower business impact but degraded).

IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2024-3305. Severity: P2. Handoff to daytime oncall at 3305002380.

CS-Emma: Drafting customer note: "We observed transient timeouts after a canary deploy that were mitigated by an immediate rollback. We’ll follow up with root cause and remediation ETA." cc @ops@customers

Alex: Quick actions to include in postmortem: add canary RTT alert, automatic rollback threshold at p99>500ms for 2m, and traffic draining for in-flight connections.

Maria: Saving log clips and perf traces to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/3305002022/ ; will attach to postmortem.

EngRuntime: PR link (hotfix revert + added e2e perf): https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/4821 - running CI perf suite.

OpsLead: Handing off to morning oncall. If any lingering anomalies reappear, escalate to SRE lead. Thanks all :white_check_mark:

SRE-Oncall: Closing live incident thread; follow-ups in #incident-3305002022.

(End of thread)
